0022600109.text: The San Antonio Spurs (0-2, on a two-game losing streak and 12th in the West) visit the Dallas Mavericks (1-1, on a one-game winning streak and 9th in the West) in the Spurs' third game of the 2026-27 season. Out for San Antonio are Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while Dallas is without Caleb Martin (thumb, sprain), Cooper Flagg (shoulder, sprain), Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Kyrie Irving (knee), Santi Aldama (knee, surgery), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, including a 139-120 win in San Antonio on April 10.
